LESSON: ENTERPRISE PROJECTS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social
Topic 2.2: Enterprise projects environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Enterprise projects environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. analyze income generating activities within the school environment
2. determine a workable income generating activity for their class
3. develop interest in income generate activities within the school environment. environment) enterprise or parents on income generating activities and report back.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. analyze income generating activities within the school environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to analyze income generating activities within the school environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. determine a workable income generating activity for their class
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to determine a workable income generating activity for their class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. develop interest in income generate activities within the school environment. environment) enterprise or parents on income generating activities and report back.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop interest in income generate activities within the school environment. environment) enterprise or parents on income generating activities and report back. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Enterprise projects environment.
2. Explain Enterprise projects environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should present selected enterprise
4. Show that you can: analyze income generating activities within the school environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Enterprise projects environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Enterprise projects environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Present selected enterprise
2. Find out from guardians or parents on income generating activities and report back.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. analyze income generating activities within the school environment
2. determine a workable income generating activity for their class
3. develop interest in income generate activities within the school environment. environment) enterprise or parents on income generating activities and report back.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
